mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, which leads to reduced corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods with a sustained decline in RSAFS over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (proxied by INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which leads to increased economic activity and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases & PAYEMS increases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreased and PAYEMS increased within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% within a month signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which leads to increased economic activity and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a potential deflationary pressure, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, which leads to increased corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods with a sustained increase in GDPC1 over two consecutive quarters.
